title: Bedrock Runtime coverage
intro: Every Bedrock Runtime operation the emulator advertises, and what Emuplane does
with it. The service is REST/JSON on `/model/{modelId}`, `/guardrail/…` and
`/async-invoke`, signed with the `bedrock-runtime` credential scope, and has no
Model calls answer a deterministic, family-aware mock reply unless
`MINISTACK_BEDROCK_PROXY_URL` points at an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, so a test
asserts the wire shape rather than model output. Both streaming operations answer
a real eventstream. `ApplyGuardrail` uses a guardrail created through the Bedrock
control plane, and the async-invoke operations keep the invocation readable after
